pin_added.question: Where does Stale live? A source missed the cutoff, but it is a Report that has to say so — and nothing on this diagram carries it between them.
Is a Rerun a PipelineRun? If so this box needs an arrow to itself, because nothing here can express 'this run is a rerun of that one'.
Is Watchlist a real entity, or just Instruments with a flag? I put it on the board because your list had nowhere for the 400 names to live.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
What we actually hold. Joined at the risk model for sizing, exposure and P&L.

Not the universe — that is the Watchlist.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Our holding in one Instrument. Quantity and cost basis are ours; ticker and asset class are the Instrument's.

That split is the one piece of this model I would defend hardest — it is what lets you talk about a name you do not own.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: The tradable thing itself, held or not. Everything else in this model points at it.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
**My addition, not yours — shaded so you can find it and delete it.**

You told me the Watchlist (~400 names) defines the universe, and your entity list had nowhere to put that. Either it is a real thing with an identity, or it is just Instruments with a flag set.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Market Feed, SEC EDGAR, News Stream, Portfolio DB, Macro Calendar.

Five of them now, and they are not interchangeable: one is ours, one bypasses the Cutoff entirely.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
The settings snapshot is yours and it is the load-bearing attribute here — it is the whole reason a rerun can be compared to an original instead of replacing it.

'trading day' is mine: reruns are *over the same day*, so the day has to be on the run for that sentence to mean anything.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Confidence is gated at 0.70 — below it, the Signal exists internally but reaches nothing a client sees.

So 'published' is a third state this box does not yet carry.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Weekly Brief, Risk Deep-Dive, Signals Digest.

Once published, frozen — a rerun never reissues one.
